title: Gabriela Gutierrez — 'That's the entire compliance problem in two sentences'
summary: Gutierrez works in compliance and ethics. She quoted Eric's line about a vault built without locks and argued on LinkedIn that integrity has to be designed into a company from the start, with financial gravity as the force that bends principled leaders away from it.
blockquote: If you create a massive vault full of the most valuable assets in the world, people are going to try to steal it from you. Obviously. But we built these companies with no locks on the vault. What are we doing?
blockquote_source: Eric Ries, quoted by Gabriela Gutierrez on LinkedIn
